scope_notice: Aggregate metrics describe system-wide counters and gauges over a scrape window. Never interpret a global queue gauge (such as llm_d_epp_flow_control_queue_size or vllm:num_requests_waiting) as an exact per-request queue wait duration.

series.name: observer_ttft_p50_ms
series.label: Aggregate Median TTFT (p50)
series.explanation: Rolling median Time To First Token across recent requests measured by Observer API.

series.name: observer_ttft_p95_ms
series.label: Aggregate Tail TTFT (p95)
series.explanation: Rolling 95th percentile Time To First Token across recent requests.

series.name: observer_itl_p50_ms
series.label: Aggregate Median ITL (p50)
series.explanation: Rolling median Inter-Token Latency across recent streaming requests.

series.name: observer_decode_tokens_per_sec
series.label: Mean Decode Throughput
series.explanation: Rolling average token generation speed across completed requests.

series.name: observer_request_duration_p50_ms
series.label: Median E2E Request Duration
series.explanation: Rolling median end-to-end request duration.

series.name: observer_requests_in_flight
series.label: Observer In-Flight Requests
series.explanation: Current active requests held open by the Observer API.

series.name: observer_requests_completed_total
series.label: Completed Requests
series.explanation: Cumulative successful inference requests observed since startup.

series.name: observer_requests_cancelled_total
series.label: Cancelled Requests
series.explanation: Cumulative client-cancelled inference requests.

series.name: observer_requests_failed_total
series.label: Failed / Rejected Requests
series.explanation: Cumulative HTTP 4xx/5xx or upstream error responses.

series.name: observer_prompt_tokens_total
series.label: Total Input Prompt Tokens
series.explanation: Aggregate input tokens across requests.

series.name: observer_generation_tokens_total
series.label: Total Output Generation Tokens
series.explanation: Aggregate generated output tokens across requests.

series.name: llm_d_epp_ready_endpoints
series.label: EPP Ready Model Endpoints
series.explanation: Number of ready vLLM pods registered in the InferencePool.

series.name: llm_d_epp_request_total
series.label: EPP Total Routed Requests
series.explanation: Aggregate requests processed by the llm-d Endpoint Picker.

series.name: llm_d_epp_kv_cache_index_lookup_hits_total
series.label: EPP KV-Cache Index Block Hits
series.explanation: Aggregate 64-token KV block lookup hits in the EPP prefix cache indexer.

series.name: llm_d_epp_prefix_predicted_cached_tokens_sum
series.label: EPP Predicted Cached Tokens
series.explanation: Cumulative prompt tokens predicted by EPP to hit existing vLLM prefix caches.

series.name: llm_d_epp_flow_control_queue_size
series.label: EPP Flow-Control Queue Depth
series.explanation: System-wide gauge of requests buffered in EPP priority-band queues.

series.name: llm_d_epp_flow_control_pool_saturation
series.label: EPP InferencePool Saturation
series.explanation: Aggregate saturation ratio across the InferencePool calculated by EPP concurrency detector.

series.name: vllm:num_requests_running
series.label: vLLM Active Running Requests
series.explanation: Aggregate gauge of requests executing in the vLLM CPU scheduler.

series.name: vllm:num_requests_waiting
series.label: vLLM Scheduler Waiting Queue
series.explanation: Aggregate gauge of requests waiting in the vLLM internal scheduler queue.

series.name: vllm:prefix_cache_hit_rate_pct
series.label: vLLM Prefix Cache Hit Rate
series.explanation: Ratio of vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total to vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total across CPU model servers.
